breadth.classification: Binance Spot USDT trading pairs only. Stablecoins, known tokenized equity/ETF assets, leveraged tokens and unmatched metadata excluded.

spot_market_activity.coverage_note: Coverage is measured against eligible exchangeInfo USDT Spot pairs; excluded asset categories are not counted as advancing or declining.
spot_market_activity.note: ২৪ ঘণ্টার Binance Crypto Spot Breadth. এটি Binance-এর USDT Spot market coverage, সমগ্র global crypto market নয়।

definitions.account: all accounts: share of accounts that are net long vs net short (headcount, not size)
definitions.top_account: top traders only: share of top-trader accounts net long vs net short
definitions.top_position: top traders only: long position size vs short position size
definitions.position_all: all traders: long position size vs short position size (Bitget only; kept separate from top-trader figures)
definitions.taker: taker buy volume vs taker sell volume in the period (aggressor flow; not positions)

method.normalize: each exchange value converted to long% + short% = 100; ratio = long% / short%
method.aggregate: simple mean of long% across exchanges within the same definition; different definitions are never mixed
method.freshness: rows updated within 24h are shown; is_stale marks rows older than 2h

limitations: Order book contains top 100 levels only, not full market depth.
Order book snapshot retrieval time is not an exchange event timestamp.
CoinBoss derivatives are aggregated cross-exchange Futures context.
Futures metrics must not independently trigger Spot BUY or SELL.
MVRV Ratio is not MVRV Z-Score.
Spot breadth represents Binance eligible USDT Spot pairs only.
ETF flows, verified liquidation heatmap, SOPR, NUPL, exchange netflow and whale entity data are not integrated.
Dashboard refresh interval does not guarantee provider update frequency.
